title: For colleges: campus stalls and seminars in Kolkata · AquaTerra
description: For college students and societies: {count} AquaTerra drives on Kolkata campuses since {firstYear}, from a sharbat stall to an animal welfare seminar.
lede: AquaTerra is a student-run charity in Kolkata, and a few of our drives have happened on college campuses. Since {firstYear} we have run {count} drives at colleges and institutes: a sharbat stall, an animal welfare seminar and a custom T-shirt stall. A college society that wants to host a drive can start with the contact page.

sections.heading: the three campus drives so far
body: The first was a Sharbat Seva distribution drive at JD Birla Institute in May 2024, where sharbat with fragrant herbs brought a burst of coolness to the crowd. The drive notes 20 litres of Rooh Afza distributed. In July 2025 the Pawtect animal welfare seminar ran at MCKV Institute of Technology, where volunteers talked about kindness and protection for animals. The seminar notes forty children taught, so it reached younger children as well as students.

sections.heading: a T-shirt stall over three days
body: In March 2026, volunteers ran a custom T-shirt stall for three days at Xaviers University, Kolkata, in Newtown. The drive notes 100 T-shirts sold and more than four hundred students passing the stall, run by eight volunteers. A stall puts AquaTerra's work in front of students where they already are on campus, and it keeps that work in view for as long as the stall runs.

sections.heading: what a college can host
body: So far a college has hosted three kinds of drive: a distribution stall, an animal welfare seminar and a custom T-shirt stall. Those are the formats a college society can ask about, and each is described on this site with its date, place and objective.

A college that wants a bigger role can read [how students run AquaTerra](/impact/student-leadership), which explains the team and how members join. Membership is for students aged fourteen to nineteen, and the team that runs the drives is made up of members.

sections.heading: how a college gets in touch
body: Write through the [contact page](/contact) with the campus, the kind of drive and the dates you have in mind. For a larger joint piece of work, the [collaborations page](/collaborations) is the other place to start. If you are a student who wants to know more about volunteering with AquaTerra as a teenager, the page on [volunteering for teenagers in Kolkata](/impact/volunteering-for-teens-in-kolkata) covers the drives, the places and how to join.

learnings: A campus drive can be a stall, a seminar or a distribution day, and each of the three so far ran in a single place.
A stall keeps the work in front of students for several days, as the Xaviers University stall did across three days.
Colleges have hosted welfare work too: the animal welfare seminar at MCKV Institute of Technology taught children as well as students.

faqs.q: Can a college host an AquaTerra drive?
faqs.a: Yes. Colleges have hosted AquaTerra drives: a sharbat stall at JD Birla Institute in May 2024, an animal welfare seminar at MCKV Institute of Technology in July 2025 and a custom T-shirt stall at Xaviers University, Kolkata, in March 2026.

faqs.q: Does AquaTerra run seminars at colleges?
faqs.a: AquaTerra has held an animal welfare seminar at MCKV Institute of Technology in Kolkata in July 2025. The Pawtect seminar spoke about kindness and protection for animals, and it is written up on this site.

faqs.q: What did AquaTerra do at Xaviers University in 2026?
faqs.a: AquaTerra ran a custom T-shirt stall for three days at Xaviers University, Kolkata, in Newtown in March 2026. Eight volunteers ran the stall, and the drive notes 100 T-shirts sold.

faqs.q: Can a college student volunteer with AquaTerra?
faqs.a: AquaTerra's members are students aged fourteen to nineteen, and they join by signing in with Google and waiting for an approval. A college society can host a drive with AquaTerra through the contact page.
